reason: The image-only reading mistook the mensura abbreviation for maior/minor and read the overlying paper as fragment text; rereading the pastedown against Otto's edition corrected the readings and located both passages.
sources: A. Otto (ed.), Johannis Daci Opera, Corpus Philosophorum Danicorum Medii Aevi I.2 (Copenhagen 1955), De gradibus formarum, pp. 554-555 and 561 (Google Books snippets, volume W6_-U19xpMgC)
O. Weijers and M. Calma, Le travail intellectuel à la Faculté des arts de Paris: Répertoire des noms commençant par J (suite), Studia Artistarum 11, entry Johannes Dacus, De gradibus formarum
G. Sajó, report on the Budapest manuscript, fols. 8v-15r, in Philosophes médiévaux (1954) (Google Books snippet)
text:
Source-assisted reading of F-yybk, made after seeing Otto 1955 (Google Books snippets). A research reader reread all visible lines of canvas 0 (lines 2-11) and the joint line of canvas 11 on the image. The coordinator reread canvas 0 lines 8-11. Line 1 of canvas 0 (illegible) rests on the image-only reading. Accuracy has not been measured.

Conventions: () expansion, [] supplied or lost letters, (?) doubtful, ... lost or unread.
